label: Demo data: Amberkloof is an invented brand · category-only request, no website

request.category: small-batch botanical body care (marula face oil, rooibos body butter)

target.note: The hero brand Amberkloof is invented and has no website; the request names its category and area only (PROVISIONAL, spine D-06).

text:
**Assumptions:** Website none given. "Competitor" means a South African marula or rooibos body-care brand. I found no verified small-batch Pretoria East competitor. Platform and content-recipe rows marked *inferred* are not confirmed. The Firecrawl scan wasn't given, and the Instagram and Facebook pages weren't checked.

## 1. African Botanics (LA-based, South African founders)
Source: https://coolhunting.com/style/products-by-african-botanics/
- **Platforms:** Own website (confirmed). Instagram and press are *inferred*.
- **Messages:** "Love letter" to South Africa. Marula is the hero ingredient, with rooibos from Western Cape estates. Fair trade, rural communities and conservation.
- **Recipe:** The hook is a story and a hero ingredient. The body is ingredient science (absorption, antioxidants). The offer is a cause tie-in: 20% of proceeds to Baby2Baby in the 2020 campaign.
- **Works:** A clear provenance story, and it won editorial coverage.
- **Doesn't:** Premium, export-focused positioning. Nothing local, and no body butter or giveaway seen.

## 2. AFRAKARI (Pretoria presence)
Source: https://skinmiles.com/product/afrakari-pure-marula-oil/ (the page returned 403, so this comes from the search snippet only)
- **Platforms:** Retail listings such as Skinmiles. Pretoria collection is offered. Social channels are unverified.
- **Messages:** Wild-harvested, sustainable, virgin cold-pressed marula oil.
- **Recipe:** The hook is purity. The body is a sourcing claim. The offer is local collection, with no giveaway seen.
- **Works:** Clear "pure, cold-pressed" claims, and a local pickup option.
- **Doesn't:** Product-spec content only. No visible face, founder or routine content, and I found no rooibos product.

## 3. Bee-utiful Botanicals (Pretoria)
Source: AGOA business listing at https://www.AGOA.info/connect/manufacturing/cosmetics/289.html. The fetch didn't contain the listing, so this relies on the search snippet.
- **Platforms:** B2B and manufacturing directory (confirmed). Consumer social is unverified.
- **Messages:** Baobab, marula and moringa botanicals, made in Pretoria.
- **Recipe:** Not observable.
- **Works:** Local manufacturing credibility and an export-ready profile.
- **Doesn't:** Weak consumer-facing presence in the results, and no rooibos or body butter.

## Gaps
1. **Pretoria East locality.** No competitor markets to Menlyn, Lynnwood or Faerie Glen buyers, or at local markets.
2. **Marula and rooibos together.** Competitors lead with only one of them.
3. **Batch transparency.** Nobody shows batch numbers, a pour or make video, or a "this week's batch" drop.
4. **Giveaways and community.** No evidence of giveaways, refills or sampling from any of the three.
5. **Skin-routine education.** There is no routine content for dry Highveld winters.

**Next:** open Instagram, search "marula" with "Pretoria", and verify two local makers. About 10 minutes.

Sources: [Cool Hunting](https://coolhunting.com/style/products-by-african-botanics/), [Skinmiles](https://skinmiles.com/product/afrakari-pure-marula-oil/), [AGOA.info](https://www.AGOA.info/connect/manufacturing/cosmetics/289.html)
